map.槽探（探槽/刻槽/采样）设计 使用指南: Trench (Exploration Trench / Channel Sampling) Design User Guide
map.槽探（探槽/刻槽/采样）设计工具。输入槽探参数，给出探槽规格与刻槽采样布置建议，: Trench (Exploration Trench / Channel Sampling) Design tool. Enter the trench parameters to get trench specification and channel sampling layout suggestions, for reference in mineral exploration surface exposure and sampling engineering design.
map.探槽规格：按浮土厚度与基岩揭露需求设计探槽断面（底宽、深度）: Trench specification: design the trench section (bottom width, depth) from the thickness of loose overburden and the need to expose bedrock
map.刻槽布置：在槽壁按固定断面与样长布置刻槽样，控制矿化代表段: Channel sampling layout: cut channels along the trench wall at a fixed section and sample length to control the mineralised representative segment
map.工程预算：统计槽探方量与样数，估算工作量与成本: Engineering budget: total the trench excavation volume and sample count to estimate the workload and cost
map.：设计要点：探槽断面底宽一般 ≥0.6–1.2m、深度以揭穿风化壳至基岩以下 0: Design notes: the trench bottom width is generally 0.6-1.2 m or more, and the depth should reach 0.5 m into the bedrock below the weathered shell; side slopes follow the soil (for example 1:0.5 to 1:1). Channel sections are commonly 10×5 cm with a sample length of 1-2 m, cut continuously along the mineralised zone (local reference; must follow the DZ/T 0078 trench exploration code).
map.：例：浮土厚 2m、设计探槽断面 1.2×1.0m（口宽×深）、长 100m →: Example: 2 m of loose overburden, a trench section of 1.2×1.0 m (mouth width × depth) and a length of 100 m → excavation about 120 m³ (1.2×1.0×100). With a channel section of 10×5 cm and a sample length of 2 m, one sample every 2 m means a 100 m trench can yield 50 samples to control the mineralisation.
map.勘探（网度/间距/工程）布置: Exploration grid layout (grid density, line spacing, engineering)
map.主要受安全与排水限制，浅部（一般<3–5m）用探槽经济；更深宜改用浅井或钻探。深: It is mainly limited by safety and drainage. For shallow depths (generally under 3-5 m) an exploration trench is economical; deeper work should switch to shallow wells or drilling. Beyond the depth limit in the codes, shoring is required and the safety must be justified.
map.刻槽样和拣块样有何不同？: How do channel samples differ from grab samples?
map.刻槽样沿固定断面连续刻取，代表性好、可定量；拣块样为随机拣取，偏差大仅作普查。正: A channel sample is cut continuously along a fixed section, so it is representative and quantifiable; a grab sample is taken at random, has large bias and serves only as a preliminary survey. Formal evaluation should prioritise systematic sampling such as channel cutting.
